material_gate: full opaque coverage, not transparent-sprite perimeter gate
seam_status: not claimed seamless; periodic difference measured without offset, blur, edge lock or paint

visual_review.identity: Continuous cooler blue-gray compacted snow with broad pale scuffed bands and scattered flat-topped gray stone groups. Lower white coverage and bluer/shadier sheets distinguish it from snow-1. No earth patches, grass, water or glossy ice.
visual_review.detail_density: Approximately 22-27 visible stone groups rather than the proposed 12-18. Shallow broad sheets retain many secondary small value facets, above the requested 6-12 total regions.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Larger grouped stones span about 10-24 world units at 256 period; single main faces mostly about 7-16. Source count and scale deviations are documented as decorative, not gameplay changes.
visual_review.style_caveat: Broad matte snowy sheets and chunky stone faces, with some soft low-contrast fill texture and small facet boundaries still present. No aggressive black outlines or bright white glare.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native; identity retained; catalog-only preview candidate, no campaign scene pass or natural seamlessness claim.

reference_material_identity: Cooler blue-gray near-continuous snow cover with a more compacted/scuffed and fragmented snow surface, scattered gray stones and almost no vegetation. Less white and more cyan-blue than slot 0. The pixels do not establish open water or a glossy ice sheet.
period_status: candidate parent integration parameter, not bound by this source handoff
